lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs are visible posterior to the gill slits. The blobs are arranged in a staggered grid-like formation with the largest, most intense maxima located in the central horizontal band.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, particularly visible in the central flank, creating a series of anchor nodes that define a roughly rectangular grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral surface. The uppermost ridge exhibits a sharp pixel-intensity gradient, with high-luminance highlights on the superior edge and deep shadowed regions directly below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, which are smaller and more irregularly spaced than the primary lateral flank constellations.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of smaller, clustered high-luminance spots, contrasting with the larger and more orderly pattern of the lateral flank.
